summary.goal: Add Understanding tab to PlanEditorPage showing plan-level agent observations from ideation
summary.context: Understanding captures what specialist agents observed during ideation conversations. It's plan-level context (not per-step) that informs the overall planning. Displayed as a dedicated tab alongside Plan and Decisions.

acceptance_criteria.description: New 'Understanding' tab appears in PlanEditorPage tab bar (Plan | Understanding | Decisions)
Understanding tab shows AgentObservationCard for each role that has observations
AgentObservationCard displays: role name, confidence badge, observations, keywords, questions, concerns
Confidence badge colors: exploring (purple), forming (orange), confident (green)
Keywords render as inline tags/chips with accent-cyan styling
Questions and concerns have distinct visual treatment (icon prefix or background)
Cards are collapsible individually (default expanded)
Empty state: 'No agent observations yet. Chat with PlannerLead to start ideation.'
Manual edit mode for draft plans: human can add/edit observations
Tab shows count badge if observations exist (e.g., 'Understanding (4)')

design_spec.location: New tab in PlanEditorPage alongside Plan and Decisions

navigation.active_indicator: Same ToggleGroup pattern as existing tabs
